skills.name: Brawler
skills.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5241|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5141|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

skills.name: Magma Fist
skills.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff6834|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

skills.name: Flame Lash
skills.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff6615|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2046|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff10758|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4092|r Health.

skills.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
skills.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5414|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8055|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

skills.name: Burning Embers
skills.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3307|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9365|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff11418|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1712|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

skills.name: Magma Shell
skills.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff164|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.
